blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Oriental Mindoro National High School (OMNHS), Mindoro Island’s largest public high school, is securing water sources and promoting conservation to ensure uninterrupted supply for more than 6,000 learners amid the possible effects of El Niño. Arlan Bolasco, OMNHS assistant principal for operations and learner support, said the school has been assessing its water facilities in anticipation of potential shortages, a critical measure given the large student and personnel population that depends on its daily water supply.
